title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Overview

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We\'re looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for aSenior Data Engineer to join our team and take ownership of building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, can work independently, and enjoys collaborating across teams to deliver reliable solutions. You will be the primary data engineer, working closely with leadership, DevOps, research, and customer support to ensure that data flows are efficient, secure, and optimized for business needs.

You will have the opportunity to design, implement, and maintain systems that directly impact company operations, from ETL processes to data modeling and analytics readiness. The role requires strong problem-solving skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to adapt to shifting priorities in a startup-style environment. If you are passionate about data engineering, comfortable collaborating across time zones, and eager to take ownership of impactful solutions, this position offers the chance to make a meaningful contribution and grow within a high-performing team.

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or similar roles.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Apache Airflow (MWAA a big plus).
  • Experience with Snowflake.
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of solutions.
  • Previous experience in small company or startup environments.
  • Comfort working as the sole data engineer and collaborating with multiple teams.
  • Open to overlapping with Pacific and Hong Kong time zones for QA/debugging.
  • Proactive communicator, responsive on Slack during work hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with PostgreSQL (or other relational databases).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Google Cloud).
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
  • Knowledge of data quality and observability best practices.

Benefits & Perks

  • Home office

  • Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company
  • International Projects
  • Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational)

Muito prazer, somos a Atento!

Aqui no Grupo Atento – formado também pela empresa Interfile – acreditamos que a melhor experiência do cliente começa com o respeito e cuidado com as pessoas . O que faz um vendedor PaP?

O vendedor PaP também conhecido como vendedor externo, faz a prospecção de clientes através de visitas presenciais definidas por rotas ou ações externas, garantindo qualidade de entrega de resultados de vendas.

O que faz um supervisor Pap?

Seu papel é liderar a equipe na busca dos melhores resultados, garantindo que a equipe siga os direcionamentos avaliando as entregas e oportunidades propostas em cima dos desafios regionais e plano comercial!

Temos oportunidades em todos os estados do Brasil.

Quais os requisitos mínimos para concorrer à vaga?

Para vendedor: Ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino fundamental completo e experiência com vendas (de qualquer modalidade).

Para supervisor: Ter no mínimo 18 anos, ensino médio completo, experiência com vendas e liderança, CNH e veículo próprio.

Como é o processo seletivo?

Você fará seu cadastro, participará de uma entrevista com o RH e depois com o requisitante.

Processo simples e rápido! #VemserAtento!

Quais os benefícios?

Acesse a vaga da sua região e verifique as informações de salário, comissão e benefícios!#TransparêncianoProcesso!

Conheça também os nossos outros Portais de Carreiras:

Interfile – com vagas voltadas para soluções de backoffice e gestão de processos;

Portal PcD – com vagas exclusivas para pessoas com deficiência.

Esclarecemos que nenhum valor é cobrado para que você participe dos nossos processos seletivos. Caso seja solicitado a você qualquer pagamento em troca de apostilas, treinamentos ou até mesmo inscrição nas nossas vagas, fique alerta e faça um Boletim de Ocorrência na delegacia mais próxima. We’re seeking someone who is well organized, attentive to detail, and most importantly is as passionate as the rest of our team is about driving results overnight and building stronger brands over time. Media Planning & Strategy

  • Develop comprehensive media plans aligned with client goals and target audiences.
  • Conduct in-depth research and analysis to identify optimal media channels and strategies.
  • Determine budget allocation across channels based on performance and objectives.
  • Stay abreast of emerging digital media trends, technologies, and AI integrations.

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns across various platforms (e.g., Google Ads, social media platforms, programmatic display).
  • Manage relationships with external vendors responsible for day-to-day campaign management.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as leads, cost per acquisition (CPA), cost per lead (CPL), engagement rates, web traffic, and form fills.
  • Analyze campaign performance data to identify areas for optimization and improvement. Generate regular reports on campaign performance and insights.

Budget Management

  • Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize campaign performance.
  • Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing and ensure campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Identify opportunities for cost-saving without compromising campaign effectiveness.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in media buying, preferably in an agency setting or with companies providing B2B services/recruiting to software development firms.
  • Strong experience in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Ads, programmatic platforms).
  • Proven track record of managing performance marketing campaigns with a focus on results.
  • Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, third-party trackers, etc.).
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Proficiency with media buying and planning tools.

Company Benefits

  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences

title: Finance & Accounting Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Finance & Accounting Analyst role at Royal Den Hartogh Logistics

Ambitious People Realising Creative Logistics Solutions.
Where will you be working?
You will be joining Royal Den Hartogh Logistics , an international and leading logistics service provider for the chemical, gas, polymer, and food industries. Our family‑owned company was founded in 1920 and has safety and sustainability firmly embedded in its DNA. Together with our customers and partners, we continuously develop smart logistics solutions that contribute to an efficient and future‑proof supply chain.
With 54 locations in 27 countries , a team of more than 2,600 colleagues worldwide , and a modern fleet of 25,000 tank containers, 5,000 dry bulk containers and trailers, 575 tank trailers, and nearly 900 trucks , we have everything needed to make an impact on a global scale.
About The Team
At Den Hartogh Logistics, you’ll join a team of committed finance professionals who go the extra mile, take ownership, and enjoy working together. Our Latin America Finance Team ensures accurate and compliant day‑to‑day finance operations across Brazil and collaborates closely with partners throughout Latin America. We work with a global mindset, combining precision, accountability, and a passion for continuous improvement. Our office is located in Barra da Tijuca/Jacarepaguá neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro.
About The Role
As a Finance & Accounting Analyst in our Rio de Janeiro office at Barra Olímpica, you will play a key role in safeguarding our financial accuracy, supporting business growth, and ensuring the smooth execution of local finance routines.
This is a great opportunity to apply your analytical mindset, deepen your financial expertise, and grow toward future leadership responsibilities within Den Hartogh. You will work on accounting activities, reporting, invoicing, collections, and administrative routines that keep our Brazilian operations running efficiently.
Key Responsibilities

  • Execute accounting entries and financial routines in accordance with Brazilian GAAP and Den Hartogh standards;
  • Process invoices, monitor accounts receivable, and secure timely and accurate collections;
  • Prepare, analyse, and present financial reports and forecasts to support data‑driven decision‑making;
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements;
  • Coordinate with internal teams to identify cost‑saving opportunities and enhance financial performance;
  • Support payroll and tax‑related routines, ensuring accuracy and compliance;
  • Manage office administrative tasks such as document control, licensing, and audit support.
The ideal candidate
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Administration, Economics, or related fields;
  • Experience in finance or accounting plus certifications (CRC, CFA, CPA, CMA);
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian accounting procedures, taxation, and compliance;
  • Advanced analytical abilities and confidence working with financial data;
  • Proficiency with accounting systems, financial tools, and MS Office (especially Excel);
  • Excellent communication skills for interaction with Brazilian and international customers;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish is an advantage.
What We Offer
Working at Den Hartogh means joining a global family where your growth matters. We offer:
  • A competitive salary aligned with local market standards;
  • A comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, meal vouchers, and home‑office days;
  • Opportunities for international exposure, training, and long‑term career development;
  • A dynamic, collaborative, and supportive workplace where your impact is visible.

Você atuará na área de Product Design dentro da diretoria de Produto e fará parte de uma equipe multidisciplinar, relacionando-se no dia a dia com pessoas de times como Produto, tecnologia e dados.

♿ Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Main responsibilities

COMO VOCÊ VAI TRANSFORMAR A SAÚDE NO DIA A DIA:

  • Planejar e conduzir descobertas a fim de identificar e mapear oportunidades e dores relevantes dos nossos usuários e clientes, por meio de pesquisas e entrevistas com usuários;
  • Propor e participar da experimentação de hipóteses e conceitos, validando-os por meio de pesquisa com usuários, testes A/B, multivariáveis, split tests ou outros métodos de validação, a fim de ajudar na estratégia do produto;
  • Colaborar na definição de indicadores de sucesso e acompanhá-los por meio de follow ups recorrentes, para apoiar as decisões e direcionamentos do negócio;
  • Usar dados no desenvolvimento do projeto para formular hipóteses e sustentar decisões de Design;
  • Facilitar workshops e atividades de concepção junto ao time para guiar o desenvolvimento do produto, a fim de ter uma troca multidisciplinar;
  • Executar e acompanhar processos de pesquisa com usuários, utilizando seus insights na construção e otimização do produto;
  • Construir e iterar experiências que estejam conectadas com objetivos de negócio e necessidades dos nossos usuários para alavancar a estratégia do produto;
  • Definir novos fluxos; criar interfaces usando nosso design system; criar protótipos de baixa, média e alta fidelidade quando preciso; realizando o handoff e acompanhamento da sua implementação

Requirements and skills

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Visão sistêmica de negócio e entendimento aprofundado de dores e necessidades dos usuários atreladas às necessidades de negócio;
  • Domínio de princípios e heurísticas de design, boas práticas de UX/UI e proficiência no Figma.
  • Experiência em product discovery e no desenvolvimento de produtos digitais em ambientes web e mobile.
  • Excelente comunicação, com capacidade de influenciar stakeholders e facilitar decisões de produto a partir de argumentos claros e bem estruturados.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de produto e KPIs, sabendo como usá-los para orientar decisões de design;
  • Mentalidade curiosa para explorar e experimentar ferramentas e tecnologias de IA.

  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.

Join to apply for the FISIOTERAPEUTA SAE - AP 1.0 role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Avaliar, treinar e adaptar usuários para utilização de OPM - Órteses, próteses e meios auxiliares;
  • Realizar anamnese, avaliação física e funcional, aplicar e interpretar escalas, questionários, testes funcionais e exames complementares para determinar o diagnóstico, prognóstico fisioterapêutico, PTS e estabelecer as condições de alta fisioterapêutica de pacientes adultos e pediátricos;
  • Prescrever órteses, próteses, meios auxiliares de locomoção, adaptações e tecnologia assistiva para otimizar, adaptar ou manter atividades funcionais com vistas à autonomia e independência funcional;
  • Registrar em prontuário eletrônico consultas, avaliações, diagnósticos, prognósticos, tratamentos, evolução, intercorrências e altas fisioterapêuticas;
  • Emitir laudos, pareceres, relatórios e atestados fisioterapêuticos;
  • Elaborar e realizar atividades de educação em saúde, orientar e capacitar os usuários, cuidadores e acompanhantes para a promoção de uma maior funcionalidade e autonomia dos usuários, bem como na prevenção de riscos ambientais;
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de adequações com vistas à acessibilidade a ambientes públicos e privados, como também planejar adequações em ambiente domiciliar, escolar, laboral e de lazer;
  • Participar dos estudos de caso, discussão e processos de educação permanente na área da saúde dos usuários acompanhados pelo Serviço de Reabilitação Física e Intelectual desta Área de Planejamento.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação Completa em Fisioterapia;
  • Pós Graduação na área de atuação;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Experiência de 6 (seis) meses na área.

Carga Horária: 20h semanais

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

You’ll build sophisticated financial models, prepare investor and board materials, and support valuation and deal execution across software and deeptech companies. This is a hands‑on, high‑accountability role where flawless work is non‑negotiable — your analyses will directly inform key decisions and client strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is a wizard with numbers , detail‑obsessed yet commercially minded, and capable of seeing both the story and strategy behind the spreadsheets .

Part time to start, 24 hours/week (with potential to transition to full time)
Schedule: CET working hours
Location: Fully Remote

  • Financial Modelling (Forecast & Scenario Analysis)
    Build fully linked 3‑statement financial models with sensitivities and scenarios (base, downside, management).
    Create cash flow forecasts, liquidity bridges, and valuation‑ready modules (DCF, comps, transaction comps).

  • Historical Restatement & Data Hygiene
    Reconcile and clean raw data (GL exports, bank data, SaaS metrics) into analysis‑ready formats.
    Maintain version control, audit trails, and traceability from trial balance to model.

  • Reporting Templates & Automation
    Design board and investor reporting templates, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis frameworks.
    Build SaaS metrics (ARR/MRR bridges, churn, LTV/CAC, NRR) and recurring revenue templates.

  • Transaction Support (Model‑Led)
    Produce deal‑ready schedules for buy‑side and sell‑side engagements (QofE, NWC, closing adjustments).
    Translate model outputs into charts and visuals for investment memorandums and management presentations.

  • Quality Assurance & Standards
    Follow strict QA processes (FAST/SMART methodology).
    Double‑check every formula, input, and output — your work must be flawless .
    Ensure transparency through consistent assumptions pages, error checks, and version logs.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in M&A, Transaction Services, or FP&A , ideally from a Tier 1 investment bank or M&A boutique .

    • Candidates with more years of experience will also be considered if they remain flexible and open to new approaches.

  • Strong experience working with software companies ; exposure to deeptech (e.g., chipmakers) is a plus.

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets proficiency (array formulas, Power Query, dynamic formulas, structured refs).

  • Excellent grasp of valuation and deal mechanics (NWC, closing adjustments, leakage, earn‑outs).

  • Ability to turn messy data into clear historicals and models — quickly and accurately.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills — able to explain the story behind the numbers.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and ability to self‑check work before submission.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience preparing materials for investment memorandums (IMs).

  • Familiarity with CAPEX modelling and debt structuring.

  • Previous experience in software or SaaS transactions ; exposure to deeptech deals a bonus.

How Our Client Works

  • Theyown the numbers — every figure must be backed by logic, traceability, and quality assurance.

  • Theybalance precision with practicality — models should be easy to hand over and fast to update.

  • Theytranslate numbers into narratives — this role will eventually expand into creating investment memorandums where financial insights tell the story.

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics
description:
Senior Manager, Event Logistics

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops)
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team
  • Prepare and manage a health- and safety plan
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro

Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027").

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Service Delivery Manager is responsible for all aspects of Service Delivery Management for Corporate and Tournament technology support operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails working in close collaboration with the Technology teams in Brazil and Zurich, and other key stakeholders.

  • Establish and implement a fit for purpose integrated support model (including FIFA, technology partners, service providers, government entities etc.) across all phases of the project.
  • Management/implementation of IT Service management processes and procedures including the management of the ITSM tool.
  • Establish service level agreements (SLAs) in accordance with the FIFA Technology Handbook across all technology services.
  • Be the lead manager for Service Delivery area within the FWWC27 Technology Project team.
  • Recruitment of direct reports in the next phase of hiring & contracting, who will in turn be responsible to deliver their key area of scope.
  • Lead on the definition of the Asset tracking and management of deployed equipment in all sites.
  • Ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed to scope, within budget and on schedule.
  • Continuously review and make recommendations to improve technology across the tournament.
  • Contribute to the Technology readiness program, including test events and exercises, policies and procedures and training of the team.
  • Be a key member of the Technology team and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation and FIFA Technology team as defined by the operational organisational structure.
  • Lead, build and manage a strong diverse team composed of paid staff, contractors, and volunteers for operating the technology services in scope.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
  • A minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry.
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and project.

  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset.
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an “automation‑first” senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive success for users of Ubuntu and our open‑source products.

Job Summary

The IS team supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services, running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you will drive operations automation—using IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products—to both private and public clouds.

You will also improve Canonical products and open‑source technologies by providing feedback, writing bugs, or contributing pull requests, and collaborate on design and implementation with other teams.

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation and Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Collaborate closely with the IS architect to align solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply IaC experience to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS, constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re‑usability and consistency across private and public clouds, considering distributed systems complexities
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation; set up and use observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design and maintain monitoring and alerting
  • Assist and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Receive uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share experience, know‑how, and best practices with team members in design sessions, mentorship and collaborative work
  • Take final responsibility for time‑critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by IaC across private and public clouds
  • A product mindset, thriving to develop products rather than solutions
  • Python software development experience with large projects
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to databases
  • Hands‑on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Excellent communication in English across email, chat, video or voice calls and in person
  • Motivated to troubleshoot from kernel to web and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • Willingness to be flexible and learn new ideas quickly
  • Passion for fast‑changing environments
  • Comfortable working within distributed teams
  • Passionate about open‑source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2 000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team member assistance program & wellness platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the publisher of Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we must be the best.

Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Create detailed technical tickets and documentation to support repeatable environment setup and engineering handoffs.
  • Maintain internal knowledge resources for templates, industry scenarios, and technical edge cases.

Who You Are

  • You're fluent in english.

  • You think like a builder, act like an owner, and communicate like a product manager.
  • You thrive in startups : ambiguity excites you, pivots don't scare you, and you prioritize speed over perfection.
  • You believe AI is a power tool , not a novelty—and you're already using it to make your work better and faster.
  • You're comfortable translating between customer needs and technical systems, and enjoy being at the intersection of product, engineering, and sales.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, Implementation, or similar technical consulting roles.
  • Ability to write and manage technical tickets and documentation for delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, and data formats like CSV and JSON.

  • Bonus : Familiarity with synthetic data or interactive storytelling in demos. Completion of AI‑focused courses, certifications, or hands‑on projects.

title: TÉCNICO DE IMOBILIZAÇÃO ORTOPÉDICA - REDE HOSPITAL CASA - CLT
description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica.
  • Registro no conselho de Classe.
  • Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses.
  • Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos.
  • Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia.

Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você:

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Refeição no Local;
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;

Horário de trabalho

Escala 12x36

title: Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas – Americanas SA – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas – Americanas SA – Rio de Janeiro

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.
  • Investigação de fraudes e desvios: responsável por apurar fraudes, quebras de procedimentos e desvios de mercadorias nas lojas através do canal de denúncias, visitas em loja e análise do painel de indicadores.
  • Acompanhamento de inventário: responsável por acompanhar a organização e preparo das lojas para a realização de inventários, diagnosticando os resultados e elaborando um plano de ação junto às lojas para melhorar esses resultados.
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados: responsável por realizar reuniões semanais, quinzenais e/ou mensais para atualizar e apresentar resultados, discutir estratégias, e treinar a equipe de prevenção e os associados das lojas nos procedimentos preventivos.
  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.

Requisitos e qualificações

Você deve ter os seguintes requisitos:

  • Graduação completa
  • Domínio do pacote office – Intermediário/avançado
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados
  • Senso de urgência
  • Disponibilidade para viagens

Será um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento prévio em Prevenção de Perdas
  • Vivência com Looker ou Power BI
  • Conhecimento com sistemas de CFTV
  • Vivência com SAP

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

About the job

The Talent Operations Coordinator supports the recruiting and hiring processes by preparing offer packages, ensuring candidate documentation is complete, and managing compliance tasks such as background checks.

This role ensures a smooth, efficient, and compliant hiring experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable handling sensitive information.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and send offer letters and related hiring documents to candidates.
  • Collect and verify required candidate documentation (IDs, certifications, work authorization, etc.).
  • Coordinate background checks, employment verification, and other compliance screenings.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records within the ATS (Applicant Tracking System) and HR documentation systems.
  • Work closely with recruiters and hiring managers to ensure timely processing of offers and pre-employment steps.
  • Track the status of all pending offers, documentation, and background checks, providing updates to HR and Talent teams.
  • Support process improvements for hiring workflows and compliance.
  • Handle confidential information with a high level of discretion and professionalism.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience in recruitment coordination, HR administration, or talent operations preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage sensitive employee and candidate information confidentially.
  • Familiarity with ATS systems, HR platforms, or background check tools is a plus.
  • Strong communication and follow-up skills.

Important information for candidates

Apply only through our official channels.

We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated.

All open roles are listed on our official careers page: /

Verify the recruiter's identity.

All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles.

If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

Be cautious of unusual communication methods.

We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

Double-check email addresses.

All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io.

We will never request payment or financial details.

If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam.

Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Liderar o time de Suprimentos na obra, garantindo a gestão integral das contratações de materiais e serviços voltados às disciplinas civil e elétrica do projeto.

Supervisionar atividades de diligenciamento, inspeção, transporte e desembaraço aduaneiro, zelando pela fluidez logística e pela mitigação de riscos operacionais.

Promover interface contínua com as áreas de Engenharia, Construção, Planejamento e Contratos, garantindo alinhamento técnico e cumprimento do cronograma do EPC.

Gerir indicadores de desempenho da área (KPIs), reportando à liderança do projeto os resultados de performance e propondo planos de melhoria contínua.

Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração ou Economia, com registro no respectivo conselho de classe.

Sólida experiência na liderança de Suprimentos para projetos de infraestrutura, com vivência em campo de obra, com atuação direta em ambientes industriais e / ou portuários.

Domínio de estratégias de compras (Strategic Sourcing) e gestão de contratos de médio e grande porte.

Conhecimento em categorias de materiais e serviços de engenharia civil e elétrica, além de práticas de logística e comércio exterior, com processos alfandegários.

Experiência na liderança de equipes multidisciplinares e interação com stakeholders internos e externos.

Capacidade analítica para leitura orçamentária, controle de fluxo de caixa e negociação estratégica.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Strategic Planner

Location : Hyderabad, IN

Employment type : Employee Place of work : Office Offshore / Onshore : Onshore

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

To ensure the effective planning and scheduling of VSO assets in support of TechnipFMC’s projects. The VSO Planner is responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date asset schedules, supporting tender activities, and aligning operational and project timelines to optimize asset utilization and project execution.

Job Description

  • Manage and update the corporate schedule for assigned vessels using Primavera P6.
  • Monitor changes and proactively update schedules based on the latest project and operational information.
  • Create, maintain, and simulate planning scenarios across all phases of work, including Long-Term Planning (S&OP, Budget, Master Scheduling), Tendering, and Execution.
  • Ensure integration between asset and project schedules, maintaining alignment between VSO (Vessel Scheduling & Operations) and Project activities. Participate in meetings for discussions and decisions, escape issues, and provide visibility to stakeholders through the management system.
  • Ensure compliance with internal planning standards and reporting requirements.
  • Regularly interface with regional operations teams to communicate vessel movements and project status (delays, accelerations, scope changes, etc.).
  • Maintain continuous communication with stakeholders from both Projects and VSO regarding asset activities.
  • Attend weekly regional conference calls, issue Minutes of Meeting (MoM), and follow up on action items.
  • Develop ad-hoc scenario schedules to support business case preparation and strategic vessel utilization decisions.
  • Develop and report KPIs, including rework, weather impact, breakdowns, contingency time, and utilization data.
  • Plan scope by sequencing activities, tracking progress, identifying risks, working with stakeholders on mitigation plans, escalating issues, reporting, controlling delivery metrics, and participating in Obeya and other meetings.
  • Support the development of tools and processes to monitor asset activity and facilitate decision-making for resource allocation. Participate in the Asset Allocation Process and manage changes to minimize execution risks.
  • Contribute to cross-functional process improvement initiatives to enhance execution efficiency.
  • Strengthen the global VSO Planning community : build competencies, share best practices, foster collaboration, and promote knowledge exchange across teams.
  • Identify and / or contribute to global planning improvement initiatives aligned with the overall VSO and TechnipFMC strategy, with a focus on Lean methodology.
  • Promote the effective and diverse use of systems to simplify execution and increase operational visibility.

You are meant for this job if :

Minimum 2 to 4 years of experience in Project execution

Qualifications (professional, technical, academic)

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering, Administration, Supply Chain or related areas.

Experience / Skills / Knowledge

  • A working knowledge of offshore vessels or manufacturing
  • Minimum 2 to 5 years of experience in Project execution
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze trends or deviations from standards and recommend creative and unique cross functional solutions
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the communication process and ensures effectiveness (written, verbal and listening) across functional boundaries.
  • Prepares and delivers somewhat simple proposals and reports to planning audience.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Open to give and receive constructive feedback.
  • Good workload management and organisation skills.
  • Confident in hosting meetings and presentation skills.

Technical / General Competencies

  • Primavera P6, Microsoft Project
  • Microsoft Excel (Advanced user)
  • Data analysis
  • Developing and using KPIs

Purpose

  • Planning and Scheduling: You develop and maintain detailed project schedules, incorporating all phases from design to commissioning. You use tools like Primavera P6 or MS Project for schedule management.
  • Cost Control: You prepare, monitor, and update project budgets. You track expenditures and analyze variances to ensure financial control.
  • Progress Monitoring: You collect and analyze data to assess project performance. You produce regular progress reports, highlighting any issues or deviations.
  • Risk Management: You identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies. You implement contingency plans to address unforeseen challenges.
  • Coordination: You collaborate with project managers, engineers, contractors, and stakeholders to ensure alignment and communication across all project activities.
  • Documentation: You maintain comprehensive project documentation, including schedules, budgets, progress reports, and change orders.

Join to apply for the Card Authority and Disputes Administrator role at Paymentology .

At Paymentology , we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. As the first truly global issuer‑processor, we give banks and fintechs the technology and talent to launch and manage Mastercard and Visa cards at scale across more than 60 countries. Our advanced, multi‑cloud platform delivers real‑time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Card Authority and Disputes Administrator to manage and process chargebacks, transaction disputes, and card authority operations across global card networks. This role ensures every case and authorisation exception is validated, documented, and resolved in line with regulatory and card scheme standards. You’ll play a key role in protecting clients and cardholders from financial loss while upholding Paymentology’s operational integrity, operating independently on assigned cases and prioritising workload against SLA and regulatory deadlines.

Responsibilities

  • Handle and process cardholder disputes involving authorised and unauthorised transactions.
  • Conduct detailed investigations using multiple internal systems and external partners.
  • Validate data accuracy and ensure all documentation meets compliance and network standards.
  • Determine appropriate actions and craft timely, accurate responses to networks within SLA and regulatory timelines.
  • Oversee card authority processes including transaction approvals, declines, and authorisation reviews.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams and clients on dispute outcomes, escalations, and card authorisation queries.
  • Maintain current knowledge of card scheme rules, dispute categories, and operational procedures.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in dispute resolution, authorisation processes, and reporting accuracy.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of Visa/Mastercard dispute and card authorisation processes and compliance standards.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word) and case management tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Analytical, customer‑centric, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to work to tight deadlines.
  • Able to coordinate with card network partners, client operations teams, and internal reconciliation staff to ensure compliance and customer satisfaction.
  • 2–4 years in dispute resolution, card operations, or financial customer service.

What You Can Look Forward To

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. You’ll be part of a diverse, global team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact through what we do. This hybrid reporting role is pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission by ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows. The manager will handle pre‑ and post‑award responsibilities, working collaboratively with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary POC for all assigned departments within the college for pre‑award and post‑award support. This position has a primary reporting line to the Office of Research for strategic oversight, training, and compliance. A dotted‑line reporting relationship with the Associate Dean for Research allows for alignment with the day‑to‑day priorities of the assigned college. The incumbent will serve as a bridge between central oversight and college‑specific needs, ensuring the success of research activities across the institution. External contacts include representatives from the federal government, other colleges and universities, professional associations, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre‑Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post‑Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university‑wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in effective multi‑tasking in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization, strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a busy, high‑volume, and deadline‑driven work team environment that requires coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to reprioritize to accommodate emergency request.
  • Must be able to speak confidently when communicating with investigators and internal and external research stakeholders, excellent customer service skills, and outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Incumbents must be able to write and interpret technical contract language, understand its implications, and effectively communicate with and serve as liaisons between granting agencies, University administration, and the principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS (foreign equivalent or higher) in Business, Finance, Accounting, or other related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non‑specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross‑functional, fast‑paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description cannot be construed as a contract for employment.

Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full‑time, permanent position. CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post‑processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading‑edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO₂ Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high‑level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client’s satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all‑inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post‑secondary degree or related graduate or postgraduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem‑solving skills.
  • Self‑motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi‑task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state‑of‑the‑art engineering software.

  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self‑motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Desenvolver a sistematização da assistência de enfermagem à populações sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual e coletiva, incluindo ações no domicilio, conforme epidemiologia local. Realizar a organização das atividades das equipes de trabalho, bem como dos processos de enfermagem sob sua responsabilidade. title: Analista de Planejamento Sr | Rio de Janeiro
description:
Nesta oportunidade de Analista de Planejamento Sr, você irá realizar o planejamento a curto, médio e longo prazo das áreas de atendimento receptivo e / ou ativo, observando cenários de forecast e dimensionamento de capacity disponível, visando a eficiência operacional alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da central de relacionamento.

Temos compromissos com a equidade de oportunidades para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos as diferenças e temos um ambiente onde todos e todas são mais que bem-vindos, por isso buscamos diversidade em identidade de gênero, idade, cor e etnia, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, pessoas com deficiência e entre outras diversidades, pois entendemos que todas as pessoas devem sonhar, crescer e realizar.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar o forecast de chamadas a curto, médio e longo prazo das áreas de atendimento receptivo e / ou ativo;
  • Avaliar a necessidade de HC para as áreas receptivas e / ou ativas e / ou novos projetos e, caso necessário, solicitar novas contratações à área de Recrutamento & Seleção;
  • Controlar o capacity de atendimento, avaliando mudanças de comportamento em indicadores para propor a otimização de recursos;
  • Simular novos cenários de entrega de resultados das áreas de atendimento mediante premissas fornecidas e / ou conhecidas a fim de que a gestão possa tomar decisões tendo interações diretas com a alta gestão Pulse;
  • Realizar análises de tendência de indicadores a fim de prever mudanças nestes e avaliar necessidade de ações corretivas sugerindo melhorias nos processos e / ou nas atividades da operação buscando a melhorias dos indicadores operacionais e NS;
  • Avaliar o desempenho das operações por meio da criação de quartis e dados estatísticos de desvio padrão identificando os outliers e sugerindo melhorias para estes;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores (KPIs) previamente definidos, apontando possíveis mudanças de comportamento e apoiar em tomada de decisões que evitem o comprometimento da entrega dos resultados;
  • Analisar o volume de chamadas da Central, tempo médio de atendimento (TMA), nível de serviço (NS), absenteísmo (ABS), turn over (TO), aderência (ADR), propondo ações em situações que estejam aquem do planejado;
  • Revisar escalas, pausas e descansos obrigatórios em conformidade com a NR17 e CLT;
  • Realizar o dimensionamento das operações de atendimento e elaborar escalas de trabalho através de Workforce;
  • Ser referência técnica para os analistas jr, assistentes e jovens aprendizes;

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Experiência sólida na área de Planejamento, domínio em dimensionamento e forecast;
  • Ter conhecimento avançado em Pacote Office (Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação para diferentes públicos;
  • Ter criatividade para resolução de problemas com agilidade, proatividade, visão sistêmica e analítica;
  • Conhecimento de discadores (diferencial ter atuado com Genesys);
  • Experiência em construção de análises de indicadores para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e / ou operacionais;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação presencial no Rio de Janeiro.

The coordinator serves as a frontline Student Accounts coordinator, providing clear, accurate, and empathetic financial guidance to students. None

The coordinator helps students understand charges, deadlines, holds, and financial processes while ensuring issues are resolved efficiently and in alignment with university policies.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Ensures accuracy in account reviews, documentation, and follow‑through.
  • Comfort working in a fast‑paced environment and supporting evening or nontraditional service hours.
  • Ability to understand and communicate institutional billing, financial aid, and registration policies.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
  • Experience in customer service and/or financial operations, ideally in higher education or a service‑focused environment.
  • Experience supporting adult or nontraditional learners strongly preferred.
  • Ability and willingness to work evening or nontraditional hours based on program needs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with ability to provide accurate, empathetic guidance.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze accounts, problem‑solve, and coordinate with multiple campus offices.

description:
Pessoa Engenheira de Dados | Rio de Janeiro

Join to apply for the Pessoa Engenheira de Dados | Rio de Janeiro role at Pulse Client Experts

Nesta oportunidade de Engenheiro(a) de Dados, você será responsável por construir e otimizar nossa infraestrutura de dados, também atuará como uma referência técnica e mentor(a), capacitando nossas equipes de Analistas, Especialistas e Cientistas de Dados a extrair o máximo valor dos nossos ativos de dados, assumindo a propriedade de domínios de dados e garantindo que nossas soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e governadas.

Aqui na Pulse temos compromissos com a equidade de oportunidades para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos as diferenças e temos um ambiente onde todos e todas são mais que bem‑vindos, por isso buscamos diversidade em identidade de gênero, idade, cor e etnia, orientação afetivo‑sexual, origem, pessoas com deficiência e entre outras diversidades, pois entendemos que todas as pessoas devem sonhar, crescer e realizar.

Para te ajudar a entender este desafio, aqui estão algumas responsabilidades:

  • Construção de Pipelines de Dados: Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) robustos, eficientes e escaláveis, utilizando o ecossistema Azure Databricks, incluindo Databricks Jobs e Delta Live Tables (Pipelines);
  • Otimização e Performance: Otimizar a performance de queries complexas e processos de ingestão e transformação, garantindo o processamento eficiente de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para o time de dados, promovendo as melhores práticas de engenharia, governança e qualidade de dados, mentorando o time de Dados;
  • Monitoramento e Qualidade: Implementar e manter rotinas de monitoramento que garantam a saúde, a consistência e a qualidade dos nossos pipelines e bases de dados;
  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento em Data Mesh: Liderar a concepção e ser o guardião técnico de domínios de dados específicos, garantindo a qualidade, disponibilidade, segurança e documentação dos "produtos de dados";
  • Governança de Dados: Implementar e disseminar estratégias de governança de dados dentro do time, incluindo conhecimento de todos os domínios de dados, garantindo a conformidade e a segurança das informações acessadas;
  • Suporte Estratégico: Colaborar ativamente com stakeholders, Analistas e Cientistas de Dados para entender os requisitos de negócio e traduzi-los em soluções de dados eficazes e estratégicas, disponibilizando datasets prontos para consumo;
  • Disseminação da Cultura Data‑Driven: Agir como um evangelista de dados, auxiliando as áreas de negócio a compreender e utilizar os dados disponíveis para tomar decisões mais inteligentes.

Para esta oportunidade, é necessário que você:

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados, atuando em ambientes de Big Data;
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com a plataforma Databricks no ambiente Azure (ADB), dominando seus principais componentes como Databricks JOBs, Delta Live Tables, e integração com Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS);
  • Domínio avançado de Python e SQL para manipulação e processamento de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência avançada com Apache Spark / PySpark, incluindo otimização de jobs e performance;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados (Dimensional, Data Vault) e arquitetura de dados;
  • Compreensão profunda e vivência prática com os conceitos e a implementação de arquiteturas Data Mesh;
  • Experiência com práticas e ferramentas de governança de dados (Data Governance), qualidade de dados (Data Quality) e segurança;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento de código, como Git;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e mentoria.

É um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados NoSQL, especialmente MongoDB;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Gestão de Riscos para realizar a gestão dos riscos operacionais dos Projetos de Capital da empresa, do portfólio da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia - VEE. A atuação se dará durante todo o ciclo de vida do contrato, desde a captação de oportunidades no Pipeline até o encerramento do projeto.

Na área de Engenharia, essa posição irá atuar de maneira transversal junto às equipes internas das demais diretorias, especialmente em implantação, onde estão alocados contract managers e responsáveis por acompanhar os riscos. Junto às demais Vice-Presidências da empresa, a função atuará de forma integrativa ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos contratos, garantindo comunicação fluida e tomadas de decisão multidisciplinar.

Essa posição tem como objetivo principal melhorar a previsibilidade e assertividade dos resultados do portfólio, através da predição das tendências identificadas na gestão de riscos.

Responsabilidades

  • Estandarização de Processos: garantir que o processo de Gestão de Riscos seja seguido e contribuir para adequação às necessidades da VEE sempre que necessário.
  • Gerenciamento dos Riscos: identificação, análise, avaliação e tratamento dos riscos presentes em um determinado ambiente, de forma a minimizar as vulnerabilidades, maximizar as oportunidades e manter ou fortalecer os pontos fortes deste ambiente.
  • Gestão de interesses das vice-presidências envolvidas: trabalhar com níveis hierárquicos adequados, garantindo atendimento das necessidades operacionais e estratégicas das demais áreas.
  • Monitoramento e Controle: coordenar e garantir que as ações de monitoramento necessárias sejam realizadas pelas equipes técnicas (desde simples revisões até reassessments dos contratos), atuando em conjunto com os gestores do contrato e o planejamento e controle para reavaliação dos valores de contingência.
  • Gestão da Informação: consolidar informações sobre os riscos nos projetos do portfólio, monitorando e controlando, através das equipes técnicas, o grau de severidade de cada um desses projetos, tanto qualitativa quanto quantitativamente.
  • Educação no tema Riscos: apoiar o pessoal envolvido na Gestão de Riscos Operacionais dos diversos projetos no aprofundamento do conhecimento na disciplina e como a mesma se relaciona na gestão da carteira.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração ou afins;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de riscos de projetos e/ou contratos;
  • Habilidade de comunicação fluida, criação de sinergia entre grupos de trabalho, capacidade de síntese de alto volume de informação, visão sistêmica.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento e/ou experiência envolvendo: formação de preço/orçamento, gestão de custos;

Benefícios
